title: epidendrum tabulare
intro: Epidendrum tabulare, commonly known as the table orchid, is a type of orchid that belongs to the Epidendrum genus. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and act as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Epidendrum tabulare include its anti-anxiety and anti-depressant properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids and phenolic acids, that have been shown to have a sedative effect on the nervous system. However, more research is needed to confirm the full extent of its therapeutic actions and health benefits.
